messages:
anya (marketing): Planning to publish the Wave release announcement tomorrow 11:00am PT. Need final changelog link, docs quickstart anchor, a 2-sentence bench blurb, confirmed canary window, and inbound lead routing rules. Can engineering and docs confirm?

mo (eng): Canary window: 10:15010:35am PT at 25% with a 10m watch, then promote to 100% if stable. Draft changelog here: https://redwood.dev/changelog/wave-rc1 (WIP). Will add rollback notes.

sam (docs): Docs quickstart published at https://docs.redwood.dev/wave#quickstart. I trimmed examples to a single curl + Node snippet for the post. Use that anchor in the announcement.

lia (product): Headline options incoming. Proposed subhead: "Wave adds safer rollouts and clearer observability for production inference." Short CTA for webinar: "Sign up to see the launch demo and perf breakdown."

omar (sales): For inbound routing, tag webinar signups lead.source=wave_webinar and route to the EMEA AE queue. Also add lead.interest=dedicated when people select capacity. I can configure Intercom once marketing confirms tags.

mo (eng): Changelog updated: https://redwood.dev/changelog/wave-rc1. Ops rollout snippet:

```
rollout:
  type: canary
  initial: 25
  watch: 10m
  promote_on: stable
  fallback: previous-release
```

Auto-fallback if p95 > 320ms for 3m.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by mo for 2024-09-03T10:15:00-07:00. CI checks passing. :rocket:

anya (marketing): Omar please add the Intercom rule and confirm. Lia, drop the two headline variants by EOD so I can finalize the post. Bench blurb should mention p50/p95 improvements and batching/KV-cache impact in 2 sentences.

lia (product): Short: "Redwood Wave: safer, observable rollouts". Long: "Redwood Wave: production-focused rollout controls and observability for hosted, dedicated, and private inference." Subhead added to the draft doc.

omar (sales): Intercom rule added and smoke-tested. Leads surface in SF with tags wave_webinar + campaign=wave_launch. Dedicated interest flagged.

mo (eng): Canary started on schedule. Early perf: p50 130ms, p95 290ms. Watching traces; no anomalies yet.

sam (docs): Verified docs anchor and screenshot assets. Link again: https://docs.redwood.dev/wave#quickstart.

anya (marketing): Final checklist: changelog -> https://redwood.dev/changelog/wave-rc1; docs -> https://docs.redwood.dev/wave#quickstart; webinar slot confirmed; lead routing in place. Publish at 11:05am PT after canary steady. Everyone okay? :thumbsup:

mo (eng): :thumbsup:

sam (docs): :thumbsup:

lia (product): :thumbsup:

omar (sales): :thumbsup:

anya (marketing): I'll post the final announce copy 30m before launch for a quick sign-off. Thanks all!
